title: Bedroom — UI Vertical Slice
subtitle: A focused scene for testing dialogue, choices, free text, history, and preferences

locations.name: Your Bedroom
locations.description: Morning light spills across the floorboards. Your half-packed bag rests near the desk, and Mina waits by the window for an answer.

actors.name: Mina
actors.description: A thoughtful university student carrying a worn black backpack.
examples: You're doing the thing where you pretend you're not tired.
Sit. I'm not making tea for someone who hovers.
actors.goal: Make sure the player is ready to leave without rushing them.
actors.voice: Natural modern speech, short sentences, dry warmth.

scriptedScenes.title: One last thing
scriptedScenes.opening: Mina shifts the strap of her backpack and studies the half-packed room.

pages.speaker: mina
pages.text: You keep looking around like the room might remind you what you forgot.

pages.speaker: mina
pages.text: So—are you ready, or do you need another minute?

choices.label: Tell her you’re ready
choices.result: You shoulder your bag. Mina smiles, relieved that you finally made the decision.

effects.text: The player chose to leave the bedroom with Mina instead of delaying.

choices.label: Ask for one more minute
choices.result: Mina nods and turns toward the window, giving you space without making a fuss.

effects.text: The player asked Mina for a quiet minute before leaving.
